description: Standalone Next.js app for quick browser-scoped polls with JSON-file persistence.

completed_modules.description: Endpoint POST /api/polls + GET /api/polls/:id, JSON-file store with atomic rename lock, home form with 2-5 option inputs.
POST /api/polls/:id/vote with httpOnly cookie idempotency + SSR /p/:id page with vote form / closed / already-voted branches.
POST /api/polls/:id/close with timingSafeEqual token check + /p/:id/manage page (token-gated) with close button.
/p/:id/results server-rendered with recharts BarChart (dynamic ssr:false) + 3s polling while status=open.

apps.quick-polls: . — nextjs (standalone: código en la raíz del repo)
